Anna (Platform): Heads-up — kicking off coordination to add per-route/model SLO dashboards (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Need runtime + infra inputs and UX expectations. Can infra/runtime teams confirm what metrics we can emit with which labels? @Sam @Oliver @Marta :eyes:

Sam (Runtime): We can emit per-request latency histograms and token counters from the runtime. Important caveats: batching changes observed TTFT; KV cache hits/partials affect "effective" latency. Labels we can reasonably add: model_id, model_version, route (api name), region, priority, quant_variant. But cardinality explodes if we include customer_id or prompt_hash.

Kai (Console): From the UI side we want low-cardinality defaults and ability to filter. UX asks: default grouping = model_family + route (e.g., gptx-2 / chat.generate), with quick toggles for region and priority. For rollouts we want a traffic-weighted delta view (percent change vs baseline) for P95 and TTFT.

Marta (SRE): Cardinality warning: Prometheus/TSDB will get crushed if you emit histograms with 6+ high-cardinality labels. Two options: a) runtime emits histograms with a small label set and infra runs a rollup job to attach route metadata b) runtime emits per-request JSON into our log pipeline and we pre-aggregate. Also suggest storing HDR-like summaries (store buckets) for 7d raw, and precomputed percentiles for 30d.

Oliver (Infra): We can support either path. Rollups are cheaper: add a job that aggregates request_latency into minute-level p50/p95/p99 per keyset. We can also add a metrics pipeline that ingests histogram buckets and persists compressed histograms in object storage for longer retention. Pricing note: export volume will increase by ~x3 if we keep raw histograms.

Sam (Runtime): Proposed telemetry contract (minimal label set):
```
# metrics emitted per request
request_latency_seconds_bucket{model_family,model_version,route,region,priority}  ...
request_latency_seconds_count{...} ...
request_latency_seconds_sum{...} ...
tokens_emitted_total{model_family,model_version,route,region,priority} ...
requests_total{model_family,model_version,route,region,priority} ...
# optional: batch_size, kv_cache_hit boolean (0/1)
```
This lets infra compute P50/P95/P99 via histogram_quantile or rollup. TTFT = first_token_timestamp - request_start_timestamp (we can emit first_token_latency_seconds as a counter/histogram too).

Anna (Platform): This looks good. Two asks: 1) final label set to freeze (trying to avoid churn) 2) example queries for Console to render tokens/sec and TTFT.

Sam (Runtime): Example PromQL-ish queries we plan to expose (approx):
```
# P95 latency by route (1m rollup): histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_family, route))
# tokens/sec by route: sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model_family, route)
# avg tokens per request: sum(increase(tokens_emitted_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(increase(requests_total[5m])) by (route)
# TTFT P95: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(first_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_family, route))
```
Note: if we go with rollup job, Console should query precomputed p95 series rather than raw histograms.

Kai (Console): For the UI: show 3 quick presets: "Overview" (model_family aggregated), "Route" (route + model_version), "Rollout" (compare baseline vs canary). Overlay baseline as dotted line and show % delta box for P95 & TTFT. Also add a tokens/sec heatmap for capacity planning.

Marta (SRE): Retention proposal: raw histogram buckets -> 7d (hot), minute-level aggregates with p50/p95/p99 -> 90d (warm), 6h rollups for 365d (cold). Backfill plan: if we change labels later, backfilling is expensive; prefer freeze small label set now.

Oliver (Infra): Infra actionables: 1) add minute-rollup job (k8s cron) to compute pXX per label set 2) add compressed histogram archival to object store 3) quota alerts for metric cardinality. We'll need estimated cardinality numbers from runtime (expected unique combos per day).

Sam (Runtime): I'll add telemetry PR with the minimal label set and example metrics by EOD Fri. I need owners to sign off on labels: @Anna @Kai @Marta @Oliver. Also will add first_token_latency histogram emission.

Anna (Platform): Sounds good. Next steps: schedule 30m sync Monday to finalize labels and Console query contracts. Please drop estimated cardinality in this thread before EOD so Infra can size TSDB. Thanks :tada:

deploy-bot: scheduled message: "Reminder: telemetry PRs go through metric-policy check — please add feature flag and test harness."
